full_judgment: 4. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the appellants in both the appeals has referred to rule 30 of the State Acquisition Rules and submitted that the said Assistant Revenue Officer while exercising jurisdiction under section 30 of the Acquisition Rules, 1951 in the matter of preparation of rent rolls undoubtedly acting as a Revenue Court against which order a further appeal lay inasmuch as the proceeding is barred in respect of the allegations under section 471 of the Penal Code under the provision of section 195(1)(c) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and as such the proceeding is liable to be quashed as not in accordance with law.
